what: A shared task brief pointed to certain files as evidence a fix had landed, and one of those paths did not actually exist in the project, discovered only once someone went looking for it by hand.
rule: A shared brief's own file references are checked against the real project before anyone trusts them.
fix: Enforcement: validation now reads a shared brief's own file references and warns when one names a path missing from the project. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-q.test.mjs`.
